subject: slovakian
summary: Slovak letters render correctly and the attached reading texts are the right passages, opening on the passage with no other questions visible. The faults are in how the cards are cut and how the scheme is explained. A one-mark vocabulary card shows only the bare phrase with no instruction, so the student is not told what to do with it. Essay cards are inconsistent: one shows no criteria and a 0-40 number grid under a paragraph of explanation, another shows four criteria as tick boxes with no marks. Section headings from the scheme (positive side / negative side) are written as grey editorial notes inside the first tick box of each group instead of as headings.

issues.title: Question is a bare phrase with no instruction
issues.detail: The whole question is 'nezanechať stopu na internete (5. odsek)'. The instruction it belongs to (explain the phrase in your own words) is missing, so a student landing on this card is not told what is being asked. The phrase is also fully underlined in orange.
issues.suggested_fix: Show the parent instruction as the stem line above the phrase, and put the phrase in quotation marks.

issues.title: Essay card with no criteria and a 0-40 grid
issues.detail: The scheme area says 'The scheme prints no answer for this part', then eight lines of grey text on the phone explaining what the scheme does and does not reprint, then 41 number buttons. The heading still says 'Select the points you actually got'. The other essay card in the same subject (card 5) does show four criteria, so the two essay cards look and behave differently.
issues.suggested_fix: Use the same four criteria on every essay card if they apply, or drop the grid and the explanation and leave only the three self-grade buttons with one plain line.

issues.title: Scheme headings written as grey notes inside tick boxes
issues.detail: The scheme groups its points under 'positive side' and 'negative side'. On the card this appears as grey text inside the first tick box of each group: 'The scheme prints this point and the four below it under its heading "Pozitívna stránka youtuberingu: youtuberi".' The first box has nine lines of grey note on the phone before a one-line point. Points also keep their trailing commas from the original list.
issues.suggested_fix: Render 'Pozitívna stránka' and 'Negatívna stránka' as real sub-headings above their groups; remove trailing commas.

issues.title: Essay criteria shown as tick boxes with no marks
issues.detail: Four criteria (comprehension, coherence, language command, grammar) each have a tick box but no marks or weights, under a ten-line grey note on the phone. Ticking a criterion says nothing about how well it was met. The card is referenced as Section II Q1 while its text is the 300-word essay normally in Section III.
issues.suggested_fix: Present criteria as a plain checklist labelled 'What the examiner looks for', without tick-for-marks behaviour, and shorten the note to one line. Check the section label.

issues.title: Single block answer with one tick; essay instruction run into title
issues.detail: Card 2's scheme is one 18-line paragraph on the phone with a single 5m tick. Cards 3 and 5 run the instruction 'Napíšte esej (asi 300 slov) na jednu z dvoch nasledovných tém:' straight into the single title shown, and on card 3 the orange underline covers the instruction and half of the title, stopping at 'Je'.
issues.suggested_fix: Label card 2's text 'Sample answer' and split into sentences; put the essay instruction on its own line; remove the underline.

good_examples.why: Nine short, separate scheme points that can each be ticked
Clear discussion question with a readable sample answer on desktop
